Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
